content:
For \(f(1+t)=f(1-t)\) to hold for all \(t\), the kink locations must match.

\[
f(1+t)=|t+2|+|t+1-a|
\]
has kinks at \(t=-2\) and \(t=a-1\).

\[
f(1-t)=|2-t|+|1-t-a|=|t-2|+|t+a-1|
\]
has kinks at \(t=2\) and \(t=1-a\).

So we need
\[
\{-2,a-1\}=\{2,1-a\}.
\]
The consistent matching is \(-2=1-a\) and \(a-1=2\), giving
\[
a=3.
\]

\[
\boxed{3}
\]
